description: cfd_2d_6dof_fish_x198_sym on 2 ranks with the lateral line (X 194): 12 probes one cell outside the hull on both sides of 6 stations along the body, material points of the body frame that follow the deforming flank; pressure and the fluid velocity relative to the hull (rigid-body motion and deformation) in the body frame, interpolated by the rank that owns the probe and summed, in REEF3D_6DOF_lateralline_0.dat.
